title: 11 Best Thali Restaurants in Jaipur (2026)
description: Reddit-backed guide to the best Rajasthani thali restaurants in Jaipur, from cultural village experiences to budget bhojnalayas.

venues.name: Chokhi Dhani
venues.verdict: The most recommended Jaipur thali experience — full Rajasthani village with folk dances, puppet shows, camel rides, and unlimited thali.

venues.name: Laxmi Mishthan Bhandar (LMB)
venues.verdict: Jaipur's most iconic vegetarian restaurant since 1727. The Royal Thali and sweet counter are legendary.

venues.name: Thali And More
venues.address: C-46 Sarojini Marg, C Scheme, Jaipur 302001
venues.verdict: The modern local favorite with multiple branches. Best value-for-quality ratio.

venues.name: Handi Restaurant
venues.address: MI Road, opp. GPO, C Scheme, Jaipur 302001
venues.verdict: Jaipur's legendary non-veg restaurant. The laal maas here is the city's definitive version.

venues.name: Spice Court
venues.address: Civil Lines, near Statue Circle, Jaipur
venues.verdict: Most recommended for international travelers. Beautiful outdoor courtyard setting.

venues.name: 1135 AD
venues.verdict: Dine like royalty inside the 900-year-old Amber Fort. The Thai-e-Amber thali is a splurge.

venues.name: Mahaveer Rabdi Bhandar
venues.verdict: Old-city institution with terrace seating. Famous for the rabdi dessert included in every thali.

venues.name: Surya Mahal
venues.verdict: Classic Jaipur vegetarian restaurant at Panch Batti. Solid and reliable.

venues.name: Shri Sharma Pavitra Bhojnalaya
venues.verdict: Highest-rated budget bhojnalaya near the railway station. Authentic local experience.

venues.name: Hotel Jaipur Heritage Restaurant
venues.verdict: Hidden gem near Amber Fort with one of Jaipur's highest-rated thali experiences.

venues.name: Anushthan
venues.address: Tonk Road, near Gopalpura Mode, Jaipur
venues.verdict: Rising star in Jaipur's thali scene with cultural ambiance.
